title: White Linen Flutter Sleeve Midi Dress with Button Front & Notch Neck
description:
Soft, breezy and quietly romantic – a pure linen midi dress with fluttery short sleeves and a delicate notch neckline. A row of pearl-finish buttons runs from neck to hem, a fitted bodice with princess seams shapes the waist, and the A-line skirt swings beautifully with a front slit. Made for summer days, holidays, brunch dates and garden parties.

✦ The Details
• Pure linen A-line midi dress with a cotton lining
• Notch (split) round neckline
• Short flutter / puff sleeves
• Full front button placket with pearl-finish buttons
• Fitted bodice with princess seams and a defined waist
• Front slit at the hem for easy movement
• Midi length

✦ Fabric & Craft
Made from pure linen with a soft cotton lining, so it stays breathable and comfortable and is never see-through. Linen gets softer with every wash and creases naturally – that relaxed texture is part of its charm. Stitched in our own Jaipur unit.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with a flowing A-line skirt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Sunglasses, a rattan bag and clear wedges for a holiday look. Pearl drop earrings and a woven clutch for brunch. Add a light denim jacket or a camel trench when the evening gets cool.

✦ Shade Card – Choose Your Colour
Shown in white. Pick White, Ivory, Beige, Sage Green, Sky Blue, Blush Pink or Black from the shade card and we will stitch this exact dress in your colour – same price. Colours other than white are made to order and dispatch in 5–7 working days.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Midi Dress (pure linen with cotton lining)
care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash cold on a delicate cycle. Dry in shade. Iron while slightly damp on medium heat.
